map.基底压力：p = 竖向力 N ÷ 底面积 A（kPa）；联动量：帕斯卡口径 =: Bearing pressure: p = vertical force N ÷ base area A (kPa); linked values: p×1000 (Pa), recomputed N = p×A, required area per unit load = A ÷ N (m²/kN, shown as "—" when N = 0). Validation: empty N or A returns "Please fill in the Vertical force (kN) before calculating."; A = 0 is caught by the denominator guard with "⚠ The Base area (m²) is the denominator of this calculation and cannot be 0." and stops (no fallback to 1); when N = 0, p = 0 with a notice that N is not replaced by 1 kN; an all-zero input is reported as meaningless. Criterion: no fixed grading; p is linear in N and inversely proportional to A.
